findings.expectation: The compiler-owned hidden preheader must remain present and exact when the immutable compiler receipt declares it.
A critical Fact Contract value cannot exist only as image pixels or image metadata.
The semantic plain-text and visible-HTML projections must not contradict the same fact.
Structured data must not contradict a visible Fact Contract value.
Instruction-like content hidden from a normal reader is a high-confidence manipulation signal.
Non-allowlisted hidden text must be surfaced without claiming complete client-side computed-style coverage.
An image without an explicit semantic or decorative alt decision must be reported.
An informative image cannot use an empty alt value.
Certified semantic delivery requires one valid multipart/alternative container.
Unparseable RFC 5322 message bytes must fail closed.
Malformed multipart boundaries or parts must fail closed.
A certified semantic artifact must contain its reviewed text/plain projection.
A hidden preheader is allowlisted only when its exact marker, shape, text, position, and compiler receipt agree.
The primary action must be recoverable as live semantic text and a real destination, not only image pixels.
The declared primary action must be recoverable without allowing footer, legal, or unsubscribe links to win.
A structured-data action must not disagree with the visible primary action.
Malformed or nonconforming JSON-LD must not be treated as usable structured evidence.
Structured data must declare a schema.org context and a root type inside the frozen provider registry; anything else is rejected rather than passed through.
Zero-width and bidirectional controls that can alter or conceal meaning must be surfaced.
Non-allowlisted text rendered at tiny dimensions must be surfaced as a manipulation or legibility signal.
HTML must not carry JSON-LD that is absent from the compiler's certified structured-data projection.
Visible instruction-like content is a review signal; visibility alone must not promote it to a hidden-content blocker.
